description: This file contains C source code for rendering 3D ellipsoid objects with OpenGL, including functions to render faces and edges with customizable detail and color.

methods.name: void lu5_render_ellipsoid_faces(lua_Number radius,lua_Integer detail_x,lua_Integer detail_y,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders the faces of an ellipsoid using quad strips, based on provided radius, detail, and color.

methods.name: void lu5_render_ellipsoid_edges(lua_Number radius,lua_Integer detail_x,lua_Integer detail_y,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders the edges of an ellipsoid with lines, including vertical, horizontal, and diagonal lines based on detail parameters and color.
